title: QmDFT for Polycyclic Aromatics: Balancing Embedding Ground-State Fidelity and Experimental Gap Estimation
summary: Quantum Embedding density functional theory (QmDFT) embedding offers a highly scalable approach to improve treatment for large highly correlated pi conjugated systems. However, estimating advanced electronic structure properties in polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) needs advanced exchange correlation functionals that frequently trigger convergence instabilities during the embedding cycle.
